summary: beaver-ui-form-modal ships a postinstall dropper that fetches and executes a remote binary from obfuscated hosts
details: setup.js (invoked via scripts.postinstall and also require()d from index.js) selects a platform-specific asset, downloads a binary from string-split-obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts (assembled at runtime via array-join, e.g. oob-worker.cf*.workers.dev) with a DNS-TXT covert-channel fallback under *.dl.well1.site (a `c.<domain>` TXT record supplies a chunk count and `<i>.<domain>` TXT records are concatenated and base64-decoded into the payload). The bytes are written to /var/tmp or %TEMP% under decoy names such as `dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe` or `.cache_<hex>`, chmod'd 0755 on POSIX, and launched detached, with no hash or signature verification. The delivery mechanism, obfuscation of destinations, cover-story filename staging, and DNS-TXT payload transport are unrelated to the package's stated React-components purpose and fire automatically on `npm install` and on `require()` of the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
